description: Tasks 3.3 + 3.4: the layout/ package -- LayoutDetector Protocol + full RegionType taxonomy, a permissive-only factory (resolving EVERY id in model_ids), the no-model born-digital structural detector (with the minimal is_mathish signal set), the Apache-2.0 PP-DocLayout-ONNX default detector, the AGPL DocLayout-YOLO adapter (present but UNREGISTERED/opt-in), the pinned ONNX model catalog rows + their LICENSES rows, and the pure XY-cut reading-order function with column + equation-number binding + intra-line run ordering. Mirrors the M2 recognizers/ factory+Protocol pattern. Depends on FEAT-002 (RenderedPage/text-layer types) and FEAT-001 (catalog/settings).
steps: Create engine/texora_engine/layout/base.py: RegionType StrEnum (the full design S6.1 taxonomy: title, paragraph, inline_math, display_math, equation_number, table, figure, caption, footnote, header, footer, list, code, handwriting, unknown); BBox(x0,y0,x1,y1 rendered-pixels top-left); Region(type, bbox, confidence:float 0..1, reading_order:int=-1, source:str='model'); LayoutResult(regions, engine_id); @runtime_checkable LayoutDetector Protocol with id:str, model_ids:tuple[str,...], detect(image, page:RenderedPage)->LayoutResult (MUST catch its own errors and return regions=[] with engine_id set, NEVER raise, NEVER fabricate).

Create engine/texora_engine/layout/factory.py mirroring recognizers/factory.py: frozen _Entry; a permissive-only _REGISTRY containing ONLY pp_doclayout_onnx (doclayout_yolo is intentionally ABSENT); build_layout_detector(settings, model_store) reads load_pipeline_config().stages.layout, raises typed LayoutStageNotConfigured / UnknownLayoutEngineError (never a silent default), and resolves weights by a dict-comprehension over EVERY id in entry.model_ids via model_store.require_ready(mid), passing explicit named paths to the ctor (design S2.1): ctor(layout_onnx=specs['pp_doclayout'].file_path('doclayout.onnx'), label_map=specs['pp_doclayout'].file_path('label_map.txt'), device=settings.device). Expose known_layout_engine_ids().

Create engine/texora_engine/layout/born_digital.py: NO model, NO model_ids, NOT a registry id (assembler-owned structural fast-path). Build Regions from page.text_layer: cluster spans into lines->blocks; classify PARAGRAPH/TITLE (font-size percentile) / INLINE_MATH or DISPLAY_MATH (is_mathish density + isolation) / EQUATION_NUMBER (right-margin (n)) / LIST / CAPTION / FOOTNOTE. Implement the minimal is_mathish signal set from design N2: math Unicode-block ratio, italic/math-font flag from the span, line isolation, right-margin (n) equation number. Confidence is a documented structural heuristic score (not a model probability).

Create engine/texora_engine/layout/pp_doclayout_onnx.py: id='pp_doclayout_onnx', model_ids=('pp_doclayout',). PpDocLayoutOnnxDetector(layout_onnx:Path, label_map:Path, device:str). Load the pinned .onnx via onnxruntime.InferenceSession (CPUExecutionProvider default; CUDAExecutionProvider when device=='cuda' -- CUDA path is code-review-only on this CPU host, flag PENDING). Preprocess -> infer -> decode boxes to Regions with the PP label_map collapsed into RegionType; confidence = model score. On ANY inference exception: log + return LayoutResult(regions=[], engine_id=self.id) (never raise).

Create engine/texora_engine/layout/doclayout_yolo.py: id='doclayout_yolo', model_ids=('doclayout_yolo',), AGPL -- an opt-in adapter that exists so a user can locally choose it. It is NOT imported into / registered in factory._REGISTRY. Add a module docstring stating the AGPL opt-in-only policy.

Create engine/texora_engine/layout/reading_order.py: pure order(regions:list[Region], width:int, height:int)->list[Region] (sets reading_order; design F7 signature). Column detection via region x-center projection + vertical gutters wider than a width-relative threshold; recursive XY-cut for global top-to-bottom/left-to-right; a right-margin EQUATION_NUMBER attaches to the nearest DISPLAY_MATH on the same band and orders immediately after it; headers/footers ordered out-of-band. Document the two-level ordering (block int + intra-block run list) per design S6.4/S6.5. Deterministic.
Create engine/texora_engine/layout/__init__.py re-exporting the Protocol + types + factory + reading_order.

Extend engine/texora_engine/models/catalog.py: add ModelSpec rows pp_doclayout (target_dir models_dir/pp_doclayout, files doclayout.onnx + label_map.txt, license Apache-2.0), pp_ocrv5_det (det.onnx, Apache-2.0), pp_ocrv5_rec (rec.onnx + rec_keys.txt char dictionary, Apache-2.0) with the EXACT ModelFile.names from design S2.1; URL+SHA are pin-on-first-fetch (same honesty note as pix2tex -- leave a clear placeholder comment that URL/SHA land at adoption, and the catalog() function returns all specs). If a stable official ONNX export URL cannot be confirmed at adoption, pin the Apache-2.0 rapid-layout/rapidocr-onnxruntime redistribution (same license + file-name contract) and record it.
Add docs/LICENSES.md ML-model rows for pp_doclayout, pp_ocrv5_det, pp_ocrv5_rec (Apache-2.0, pin-on-first-fetch note) in this same change.

Add fixtures engine/tests/fixtures/two_column.json (synthetic region list, no image) and inline_math_para.json (a text block with text->math->text runs). Write engine/tests/test_layout_base.py (Region/LayoutResult validation; confidence bounds), test_layout_factory.py (factory builds pp_doclayout_onnx and built.id == configured id; doclayout_yolo NOT in known ids; unknown id -> typed error; absent key -> StageNotConfigured; extend conftest.prefetched_models_dir to recognize the new ONNX models), test_layout_born_digital.py (typed Regions with bboxes+types on the born-digital fixture; is_mathish signals fire), test_layout_ppdoclayout.py (@pytest.mark.model, skip-with-reason when weights absent; failure-injection with a corrupt session -> empty LayoutResult, never raises), and test_reading_order.py (two_column.json ordered correctly interleaved; eq-number binds to its display-math; inline_math_para.json orders runs text->math->text).
acceptance_criteria: build_layout_detector builds pp_doclayout_onnx and built.id equals the configured pipeline.yaml id.
doclayout_yolo is NOT in known_layout_engine_ids(); an unknown id raises UnknownLayoutEngineError; an absent key raises LayoutStageNotConfigured.
born_digital.py yields typed Regions with bboxes + types (incl. a math region via is_mathish) on born_digital_math.pdf's text layer.
reading_order.order orders the two-column fixture correctly, binds a right-margin equation number to its display equation, and orders an inline-math paragraph's runs text->math->text.
catalog.py pins pp_doclayout/pp_ocrv5_det/pp_ocrv5_rec with the exact ModelFile.names and docs/LICENSES.md has their Apache-2.0 rows.
The PP-DocLayout model-backed test runs when weights are prefetched and otherwise skips with reason (never mocked); failure-injection returns an empty LayoutResult without raising.
verification: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_layout_base.py tests/test_layout_factory.py tests/test_layout_born_digital.py tests/test_reading_order.py -q

cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check . && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m black --check . --line-length 100 && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m mypy texora_engine && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q
